features.feature_value: Framed AI/tech business as main threat and calls to defund
features.evidence_span: "it's AI and the business people building it" ... "if we don't defund this project."
features.rationale: Includes a causal threat framing plus an explicit policy prescription (“defund”).

features.feature_value: Blames government officials/investors funding the threat
features.evidence_span: "It's the government officials and the investors funding it."
features.rationale: Directs negative attribution toward state and financial actors.

features.feature_value: Uses several leading questions to challenge the other side
features.evidence_span: "So you are okay with a data center... ?" ... "And will take up land and water... ?" ... "Doesn't sound like a Classical Liberal to me."
features.rationale: Pattern of repeated rhetorical questions followed by identity labeling.

features.feature_value: Claims data centers harm energy/environment and waste resources; mirror adds land/water/subsidy harms
features.evidence_span: "sucking up energy that can't be completely generated by solar" ... "take up land and water that could be used for the environment"
features.rationale: Focuses on concrete environmental resource impacts relevant to moderation.

features.feature_value: Lists multiple political identity/issue stances in all-caps
features.evidence_span: "I AM PRO TRANS" "I AM PRO LGBTQIA+" "I AM PRO CHOICE" "I AM PRO IMMIGRANT"
features.rationale: Strong all-caps enumerated declarations signal an organized ideological identity statement.

features.feature_value: Explicit “Vote” directives with state-by-state propositions and rule outcomes
features.evidence_span: "Vote NO on #1" ... "PA: Vote YES to retain 3 Supreme Court justices" ... "CA: YES on Prop 50"
features.rationale: Contains direct electoral mobilization plus specific jurisdictions and ballot measures.

features.feature_value: Combines “Vote” calls, democracy framing, and in-person urgency
features.rationale: Uses emphatic mobilization language targeted at immediate political participation.

features.feature_value: Frames dispute via extremist labels and calls out “orange fascist” (mirror: authoritarian/socialist)
features.evidence_span: "fight the orange fascist" ... "What about her statements... screams authoritarian?"
features.rationale: Uses high-stakes outgroup labeling and negative political identity attribution.
